extra.workflow_note: Single-stage transparent RGBA workflow. Fixed tile 512x512 overlap64. Selectable scale 1.5x/2x/2.5x/3x/3.5x/4x. Uses SeedVR2 node with the 7B model file seedvr2_ema_7b_fp8_e4m3fn_mixed_block35_fp16.safetensors; in many installations this is the same engine users refer to as SeedVR2.5.
